g.text: Equal-degree recovery confirms on 64 new source banks

text.style: font-size: 11.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #27675c

g.text: Frozen target supported: 64/64 exact graphs, zero missing edges; original gap heuristic recovers 26/64.
64 independent banks, each with 2,400 distinct source rows; 150,618 unique identities, all disjoint from the H4y motivating sources.
Minimize degree dispersion at count cuts no higher than the median; degree 20 and graph size 810 are not supplied.
All 9,581 candidates audited; the unique regular candidate is the true graph in every bank. No minimum-degree or density guard.
Equal degree is a structural prior. Same official corpus and stated noise law, different training work; no new inference-accuracy claim.
